name: careers-page
title: Careers page
description: The careers page: the page head with the light, why join as three cards and the open roles as rows under hairlines.
use_for: A careers page; roles come through `content`.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a view
Real people or customers in the copy: Acme only
source: Built from the library and the site's surfaces (cards on --surface, the rail on --raised, hairlines, the 36px links of the header)
body:
`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`hero`, `values`, `roles`); a key left out is not shown. `menus`
passes the header menus (the live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`).

files.content:
// The careers page's copy: a head, why join in three lines, and the open roles. Both flavors read this file.
export const careersContent = {
	eyebrow: 'Careers',
	headline: 'Build the record of creative.',
	body: 'A small team, working in the open, shipping every week.',
	values: [
		{ title: 'Small team', body: 'Every person owns a part of the product.' },
		{ title: 'Remote first', body: 'Work from anywhere in two time zones of each other.' },
		{ title: 'Ship weekly', body: 'Something reaches customers every week.' },
	],
	rolesTitle: 'Open roles',
	roles: [
		{ title: 'Founding designer', team: 'Design', location: 'Remote', href: '#designer' },
		{ title: 'Senior engineer, search', team: 'Engineering', location: 'Remote', href: '#search' },
		{ title: 'Growth lead', team: 'Marketing', location: 'New York', href: '#growth' },
	],
	none: 'No open roles right now.',
}
export type CareersContent = typeof careersContent

/** The careers page's sections in order; pass `sections` to reorder them or leave some out. */
export const careersSections = ['hero', 'values', 'roles'] as const
export type CareersSection = (typeof careersSections)[number]
